messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: svc-inference-api high error rate in us-west-2. Severity: Sev2. bridge: https://redwood/bridges/BR-1234. auto-created incident-2061234567.
Maya R.: I'm on the bridge, joining now. seeing 5xxs from decoder workers, spikes started ~10m ago.
Ben C.: Copy — I can pull logs and check recent deploys, any canaries?
Sasha K.: No canary deployed in last hour. Autoscaler shows a flurry of evictions ~9:45.
Dave L.: Oncall here, taking lead. Tom, can you check GPU memory pressure on the decoder fleet?
Tom H.: Looking — memory climbs then OOM-killed a pod, several restarts. suspect rolling restart + slightly larger batch size.
Priya S.: Customers flagged: two enterprise tenants reported degraded responses and 504s. CS alerted them, flagged as impact.
Elena M.: Adding quick mitigation: scaling down batch size via config and rolling restart of decoder pool. will patch config to `max_batch_tokens: 1024 -> 512`.
Ben C.: Pushed temp config change and triggered controlled restart. watching error rate.
Maya R.: Errors trending down, latency back to normal for most requests. still seeing occasional tail 5xxs.
Oncall Bot: @Dave L. acknowledged the pager. bridge closed for active mitigation updates.
Dave L.: Good containment. We should schedule a follow-up postmortem and assign action items for alert tuning and autoscaler thresholds.
Sasha K.: Agreed. Short root cause hypothesis: a recent optimizer change increased per-request memory footprint under certain sequence length distributions. combined with autoscaler churn led to transient OOMs.
Priya S.: Customer impact: 2 tenants, partial failures for 12-18 minutes, some retries succeeded after fallback. recommend proactive outreach.
Maya R.: Action item list (quick):
- A1: Root cause deep-dive (owner: Sasha K.) - investigate model runtime diff and recent optimizer patch. due: 3 business days.
- A2: Alert surgery (owner: Ben C.) - dedupe symptom alerts, add `oom_kill` alert and reduce noisy CPU mem alerts. due: 2 business days.
- A3: Autoscaler tuning (owner: Tom H.) - make a conservative cooldown and increase min replica for decoder pool in us-west-2. due: 1 business day.
- A4: Customer comms (owner: Priya S.) - draft outreach + timeline. due: today EOD.
- A5: Postmortem doc (owner: Dave L.) - create and schedule review meeting, invite eng/ops/CS. due: 2 business days.
Ben C.: For alert surgery, here's the rough rule to add as a starting point:
```yaml
- alert: DecoderOOMs
  expr: increase(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason=~"OOMKilled"}[15m]) > 0
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "OOM kills detected on decoder pods"
```
Ben C.: Also propose a dedupe layer: group alerts by deployment + node and only page when unique group count > 2 in 5m.
Sasha K.: I'll take A1. I'll also run a diff of the last optimizer PR and try to reproduce with long sequences locally.
Tom H.: I'll adjust autoscaler policy and the min replicas; will stage in canary region then roll to prod.
Elena M.: For postmortem, suggest we include a short eval run with long-seq traffic to validate optimizer changes before any rollout.
Dave L.: Scheduling: postmortem doc created at https://redwood/postmortems/INC-2061234567 (placeholder). Let's meet tomorrow 09:00 PT for review.
Maya R.: Quick note on monitoring: add a derived SLI for successful tokens/sec per customer to better detect partial impact earlier. (Owner: Maya).
Priya S.: I'll do the customer note. pinging CS for approval.
Oncall Bot: @Dave L. assigned oncall handoff to Ben C. for followups after 22:00 PT.
Tom H.: Mitigation validated — error rate stable. closing active pager.
Maya R.: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll put the thread summary into the postmortem doc and list the A items.
Ben C.: Follow-ups: I'll open PR for alert rule changes and link it in the postmortem.
Sasha K.: Will post replication logs and test results in the doc.
Priya S.: Customer comms sent. one customer replied asking for RCA timeline.
Dave L.: Closing notes: reduce noisy alerts -> prioritize signal (OOMs, evictions, customer 5xx surge). We'll track completion of A1-A5 in the postmortem tracker.
Tom H.: Leaving final operational note: set autoscaler cooldown to 3m (was 30s) and add `stabilizationWindow` for scale down.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2061234567 marked mitigated by Dave L. severity lowered to Sev3.
Maya R.: Last: assign owners in the doc and mark blockers if any.
Elena M.: I'll review the alert PR once it's up.
Tom H.: Thanks all, standing down. :wave:
